ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, with point O as the endpoint, rays OA, OB, OC, OD, and OE are drawn successively in clockwise direction. Moreover, OB is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and OD is the bisector of $\angle COE$. If $\angle AOB=50^\circ$ and $\angle DOE=30^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $OB$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$,\\
hence $\angle BOC = \angle AOB = 50^\circ$;\\
since $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle COE$,\\
thus $\angle COD = \angle DOE = 30^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle BOD = \angle BOC + \angle COD = 50^\circ + 30^\circ = \boxed{80^\circ}$.
